We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool. Then we need to analyze isotopic patterns to identify elements like Cl (35/37), Br (79/81), S (32/34), etc. Also maybe C (13C pattern). We need to retrieve isotopic distribution for reference. Use retrieve_isotope_distribution.
